standard_prerequisites.name: The description of a profinite space as a limit of finite discrete spaces over a directed set, with the projections forming a fundamental system of neighbourhoods
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 4430-4435)
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the finite quotients whose fibres give clopen sets.

core_obligations: Reduce the covering: since the fibres of the projections form a fundamental system of neighbourhoods, quasi-compactness lets one assume the covering consists of finitely many such fibres (proof lines 4429-4438)
Choose a common stage: directedness of the index set produces one stage above all the stages appearing in that finite covering (proof lines 4439-4442)
Refine: the partition of the space into the fibres of the projection to that single stage refines the given covering and is a finite partition by clopen sets (proof lines 4443-4445)
proof_roadmap: 把 X 写成有限离散空间 X_i 的逆向极限；f_i 的纤维构成基本邻域系；由 X 准紧可设已有有限个这样的纤维覆盖 X。
由定向性取 i ≥ 所有涉及的 i_j。
则 X = ∐_{t ∈ X_i} f_i^{-1}({t}) 细化原覆盖，且是有限个开闭集的分划。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every open covering of a profinite space admits a refinement which is a finite partition into clopen subsets (author lemma at source lines 4423-4427, label lemma-profinite-refine-open-covering). The proof (source lines 4429-4446) uses that fibres of the projections to the finite quotients form a fundamental system of neighbourhoods, reduces the covering to finitely many such fibres and picks a common stage by directedness (proof lines 4429-4445). The reduction and the common stage are the content. H3.
